params.requirement: Judges in one short structured answer how the screen beside a spoken answer takes part in it: active, accompanying, referring or none. It reads one request with a few earlier turns and the screen's topics, returns a JSON object with one enum field and no prose, and runs on every turn beside the route decider, so it must answer within a few hundred milliseconds and cost next to nothing.

reasoning_effort.description: GH #1300: how long the model deliberates before it answers, in the provider's shorthand (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `none` = off, or the lowest effort a model that cannot switch thinking off takes; passed through, not checked against a list). It ships `medium`, the effort every shipped llm cell runs at unless its instance says otherwise: an instance sets it through `override_params` on this cell's path, and a registry push that names no effort resets it to this birth value. On the chat-completions wire it goes out as `"reasoning": {"effort": ...}` (default `reasoning_wire`), on the Anthropic Messages wire as `output_config.effort`; `none` switches thinking off in the form the model takes. A `reasoning` object, where one is set, outranks it; a model whose catalogue `supported_params` omits the field never receives it.

model.description: Provider model id of the screen judge. Empty as shipped, like `./decide`: the model registry's push (`in_model` with `hop.subscriber` ending in `/screen_model`) or the installing set's `override_params` names it (FU-0 measured `xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash`).

api_key.description: Provider API key. Deprecated, removed in 0.63.0: name a grant in credential_grant_id instead (#801).

credential_grant_id.description: GH #801: the grant this judge presents to get its provider credential SEALED from an access hive instead of carrying a key; it ships empty, the level that grows the talky sets it through `override_params`, and the credential arrives over the credential v-lane at `./screen_model`.

messages.description: Not required (GH #1061): the sealed credential box the access hive delivers on `in_sealed` carries `sealed` and nothing else, and a required key here would refuse it at delivery.

description.purpose: `./screen_judge`'s model (#1279): one structured answer `{screen_form}` per judged turn, through `provider_extra.response_format` (json_schema, four forms).
description.use_when: Inside talky, behind `./screen_judge`, which only calls it with `enabled` "1".
description.not_in_scope: No tools, no history of its own: the judge context comes in the one user message.
